title: Outdoor Grilled Thai Chicken Skewers
description: A jammy and shaggy Thai dish featuring marinated chicken, vegetable shortening, and a blend of spices, perfect for outdoor adventures and Buddhist temple gatherings.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, grated ginger, and garlic to make the marinade.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with vegetable shortening to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through and slightly charred.
During the last 2 minutes of grilling, add the sliced Thai red chili peppers to the grill and cook until slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the grilled chicken skewers hot, garnished with additional sliced chili peppers and a sprinkle of brown sugar if desired.
